# Imran Ali Khan

> Imran Ali Khan is a senior Flutter developer in Lahore, Pakistan with 4.5+ years of experience building Android and iOS apps. He works remotely for clients worldwide and is also open to onsite work in Lahore, Islamabad, the UAE, and Saudi Arabia. He is available immediately.

## Key facts

- Role: Senior Flutter Developer
- Experience: 4.5+ years, three companies (BJS Soft Solutions, Senarios, ISKAAN Tech)
- Main tools: Flutter, Dart, BLoC, Provider, Riverpod, Firebase, REST APIs, Clean Architecture
- AI tools: Claude Code and Cursor, with careful prompts. He reviews every line and tests on real devices.
- Apps shipped: 17+ on the Play Store and App Store
- Education: BS (Hons.) Software Engineering, The University of Haripur, 2017 to 2021

- BJS Soft Solutions: moved Windows products to Flutter, with hardware control through platform channels
